description: This file defines the class `ViewSugarpdf`, which is responsible for generating and outputting PDF views using the Sugarpdf framework within the SuiteCRM application. It manages request parameters, loads appropriate PDF generator objects, checks access control, and renders the PDF output.

classes.name: ViewSugarpdf
classes.description: A view class that handles the creation and output of PDF documents using the Sugarpdf library within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets the type, determines the PDF type to use from request parameters, and redirects if necessary.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the PDF object, performs access control checks, and handles errors before displaying.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the PDF and outputs it directly to the browser.
